https://www.express.co.uk/travel/article.text: Home Travel Travel News Warsaw has two Christmas markets (Image: Getty) Ryanair has launched a new route for cheap breaks this winter , just in time to take advantage of the Christmas markets. The budget airline announced that the first flight has taken off in its new winter 2026 route from Manchester to Warsaw Modlin in Poland. Ryanair bosses revealed the news yesterday (October 27), saying it it will operate six weekly flights on this "exciting new winter 2026 route, providing UK customers with even more choice at Europe’s lowest fares". The new route gives Brits the chance to enjoy Warsaw's two Christmas markets, including the huge Jarmark Warszawski at Plac Defilad, by the Palace of Culture and Science, and the traditional, historic market in the Old Town along the city walls. Both markets run from November to January and boast free entry, featuring classic winter scenes of chalets, Christmas trees, and an open-air ice rink. Ryanair’s full winter 2026 schedule is available to book now via the Ryanair app and website in time for cheap winter and Christmas breaks. Ryanair is launching a host of new routes for winter 2026 (Image: Getty) The first flight comes after Ryanair unveiled its newly expanded winter schedule last month, with 22 new routes from UK airports with Birmingham, Edinburgh, Liverpool, and London airports benefiting the most. Ryanair also announced that it was adding nineteenth-based aircraft at Manchester Airport this winter, helping it to run one extra route from the North West hub. Ryanair is increasing its flight frequencies on another 26 routes from Manchester, including holiday hotspots like Malaga, Palma de Mallorca and Madrid, as well as city break destinations like Barcelona, Belfast, Venice, Porto, Prague and Krakow. Eye-catching flights among the list included the new winter sunshine route from Birmingham to Marrakech, which regularly enjoys mild winter temperatures. The bulk of the other routes are to northern and western European destinations where more festive pleasures are on the itinerary.
